capture: Run ./gradlew --offline --no-daemon runGameTestServer with CREATE_PENDING_GEARSHIFT=write, then rerun with CREATE_PENDING_GEARSHIFT=read. Repeat with CREATE_PENDING_GEARSHIFT_DROPS=on or off to select separate save folders. The off fixture disables drops in both Java processes because GameTest startup resets the saved rule.
layout: Two initialized X-axis Gearshifts between adjacent Creative Motors. A +32 motor is initially the source. On tick 5 a compatible motor takes over with a magnitude of 64. One Gearshift is powered and the other unpowered before the second motor is added. On tick 8 each reverses and the server exits while the scheduled reconnection is pending.
sampling: Capture state, theoretical RPM, both motor presences, queued callback and drops. As with the Clutch fixture, Horizon compares write tick 8 and settled Java read tick 48 over three observation ticks after reopening. Absolute startup ticks differ between processes.
